loudness_rule: peak ceiling -3.0 dBFS; loudest 50 ms RMS aimed at -14.5 dBFS plus each sound's trim_db

sounds.name: jump
sounds.trigger: Player leaves the ground with a normal or buffered jump

sounds.name: wall_kick
sounds.trigger: Player kicks off a wall

sounds.name: land_soft
sounds.trigger: Player lands from a short fall

sounds.name: land_hard
sounds.trigger: Player lands from a long fall or a dash-fall

sounds.name: dash
sounds.trigger: Player starts a dash

sounds.name: stomp_1
sounds.trigger: Player lands on an enemy, first in a chain

sounds.name: stomp_2
sounds.trigger: Second enemy in the same air chain

sounds.name: stomp_3
sounds.trigger: Third or later enemy in the same air chain

sounds.name: bump_block
sounds.trigger: Player's head hits a block that still has something in it

sounds.name: bump_used
sounds.trigger: Player's head hits an empty or solid block

sounds.name: brick_break
sounds.trigger: Charged player breaks a brick with a head bump

sounds.name: shard
sounds.trigger: Player collects a shard

sounds.name: big_shard
sounds.trigger: Player collects one of the three big shards

sounds.name: extra_life
sounds.trigger: Player earns a life (100 shards or a 1UP block)

sounds.name: charge_get
sounds.trigger: Player picks up CHARGE

sounds.name: charge_lose
sounds.trigger: Charged player is hit and loses CHARGE (survives)

sounds.name: death
sounds.trigger: Player dies (hit uncharged, pit, crush or timer)

sounds.name: spring
sounds.trigger: Player is thrown upward by a spring

sounds.name: lift_ring
sounds.trigger: Player passes through a lift ring (dash refilled, popped up)

sounds.name: checkpoint
sounds.trigger: Player lights the midway beacon

sounds.name: mast_touch
sounds.trigger: Player grabs the goal mast (plays before the slide)

sounds.name: mast_slide
sounds.trigger: Player slides down the mast to the ground

sounds.name: level_clear
sounds.trigger: Level finished (after the mast slide)

sounds.name: world_clear
sounds.trigger: World finished: the Gate is lit

sounds.name: game_over
sounds.trigger: Last life lost (restart the world at level 1)

sounds.name: timer_warning
sounds.trigger: Level timer drops below 100

sounds.name: pause
sounds.trigger: Game paused or unpaused

sounds.name: menu_move
sounds.trigger: Menu cursor moves

sounds.name: menu_confirm
sounds.trigger: Menu choice confirmed

sounds.name: loose_floor_shake
sounds.trigger: Loose floor starts its 0.35 s shake after being stood on

sounds.name: loose_floor_crack
sounds.trigger: Loose floor breaks free (end of the shake)

sounds.name: loose_floor_fall
sounds.trigger: Loose floor drops (plays while falling)

sounds.name: loose_floor_land
sounds.trigger: Fallen floor lands as rubble (also crushes what is below)

sounds.name: loose_ceiling_crack
sounds.trigger: Loose ceiling chunk breaks loose (0.4 s before it falls)

sounds.name: loose_ceiling_fall
sounds.trigger: Ceiling chunk falls (plays while dropping)

sounds.name: loose_ceiling_land
sounds.trigger: Ceiling chunk hits the ground

sounds.name: press_shake
sounds.trigger: Press shakes for 0.3 s as its warning before a slam

sounds.name: press_slam
sounds.trigger: Press hits the floor

sounds.name: spike_warn
sounds.trigger: Spike vent about to fire (short tell before the spikes rise)

sounds.name: spike_pop
sounds.trigger: Spikes spring up from a vent

sounds.name: dropper_tell
sounds.trigger: Dropper lets go (player passed underneath)

sounds.name: dropper_slam
sounds.trigger: Dropper hits the ground

sounds.name: dropper_rise
sounds.trigger: Dropper winds back up to the ceiling (retrigger if longer)

sounds.name: plate_click
sounds.trigger: Pressure plate pressed down

sounds.name: gate_open
sounds.trigger: Gate slides open

sounds.name: gate_close
sounds.trigger: Gate slides shut (timed gates closing too)

sounds.name: lever_pull
sounds.trigger: Player pulls the lever

sounds.name: bridge_collapse
sounds.trigger: Lever drops the bridge: planks give way one after another

sounds.name: warden_step
sounds.trigger: Warden footstep while pacing the bridge

sounds.name: warden_hop
sounds.trigger: Warden jumps

sounds.name: warden_fall
sounds.trigger: Warden falls when the bridge collapses (scream as it drops)

sounds.name: walker_squish
sounds.trigger: Walker flattened by a stomp (play with stomp_N)

sounds.name: hopper_hop
sounds.trigger: Hopper jumps

sounds.name: hopper_land
sounds.trigger: Hopper lands (pairs with hopper_hop)

sounds.name: channel_switch
sounds.trigger: Player bumps a channel switch block: the solid and outline blocks swap

sounds.name: channel_arm
sounds.trigger: Relay boss is about to swap the channels by itself: play when its 0.3 s warning starts, it ends as the swap lands (then channel_swap)

sounds.name: channel_swap
sounds.trigger: The relay boss swaps the channels: blocks change over (plays as channel_arm ends)

sounds.name: spiky_knock
sounds.trigger: Spiked walker knocked out from below or crushed by a trap

sounds.name: spiky_hurt
sounds.trigger: Player touches a spiked walker's spikes (the sting only: death or charge_lose plays as well)

sounds.name: fuse_blow
sounds.trigger: Player bumps a fuse socket and blows the fuse

sounds.name: relay_hum
sounds.trigger: Relay boss idle hum. LOOPS: play it with looping on (the file loops by itself in Godot and has no click at the seam)

sounds.name: relay_overload
sounds.trigger: All three fuses blown: the relay boss alarms and crashes (then relay_down)

sounds.name: relay_down
sounds.trigger: Relay boss powers down and dies (after relay_overload)

sounds.name: amb_w1
sounds.trigger: World 1 ambience under the music: distant wind over dead wires, a faint signal blip. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: amb_w2
sounds.trigger: World 2 (relay yard) ambience under the music: transformer hum, far-off metal clanks, rain. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: lamp_on
sounds.trigger: A signal lamp sputters on

sounds.name: thunder
sounds.trigger: Lightning strikes: a crack, then a rolling rumble

sounds.name: menu_back
sounds.trigger: Menu back or cancel (pairs with menu_move and menu_confirm)

sounds.name: save_done
sounds.trigger: Game saved: a short two-note chime

sounds.name: voice_mast
sounds.trigger: Mast (old keeper) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_tally
sounds.trigger: Tally (trader) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_wren
sounds.trigger: Wren (kid with headphones) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_brace
sounds.trigger: Brace (lineworker) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_dot
sounds.trigger: Dot (switch operator, lamp head) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_hum
sounds.trigger: Hum (relay technician) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: talk_open
sounds.trigger: A speech bubble opens

sounds.name: talk_next
sounds.trigger: Player advances to the next line of speech

sounds.name: door_open
sounds.trigger: A small house door opens (latch, then the creak)

sounds.name: door_close
sounds.trigger: A small house door shuts (the latch drops)

sounds.name: shop_buy
sounds.trigger: Player buys something in the shop

sounds.name: shop_deny
sounds.trigger: Player can't afford it (not enough shards)

sounds.name: amb_village
sounds.trigger: Last Relay village ambience under the music: soft wind, a distant wind chime, a far-off radio murmuring. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: village_theme
sounds.trigger: Last Relay village theme, on the Music bus. Calm D major, all four voices, 16 bars at 100 BPM. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_training
sounds.trigger: Training yard music, on the Music bus. Light and bouncy C major, 120 BPM, 16 bars; opens with the FIRST LIGHT figure. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_1
sounds.trigger: Level 1-1 FIRST LIGHT music, the game's main theme, on the Music bus. Hopeful and driving, G major, 150 BPM, 24 bars. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_1_bonus
sounds.trigger: Level 1-1 bonus room music, on the Music bus. Short, playful and sparkly, E major, 180 BPM, 16 bars; a hook that climbs to the fifth, sparkle notes in the middle. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_2
sounds.trigger: Level 1-2 LOOSE GROUND music, on the Music bus. Nervous and off-balance, E minor, 144 BPM, 24 bars; opens with the FIRST LIGHT notes knocked loose into 3+3+2. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_3
sounds.trigger: Level 1-3 THE PRESSES music, on the Music bus. Mechanical and syncopated over a steady thud, C minor, 112.5 BPM, 20 bars; a stamping hook, FIRST LIGHT in minor at the end. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_4
sounds.trigger: Level 1-4 THE GATE music, the World 1 finale, on the Music bus. Tense then heroic, D minor, 163.6 BPM, 24 bars; FIRST LIGHT in minor, then turned into a major-key call. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_1
sounds.trigger: Level 2-1 RAIL HOPPERS music, on the Music bus. Bouncy A minor with rain and lightning, 133.3 BPM, 20 bars; opens with the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_2
sounds.trigger: Level 2-2 SPIKED LINE music, on the Music bus. Cautious, low and creeping, B minor, 90 BPM, 16 bars, with rain; the bass creeps through the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_3
sounds.trigger: Level 2-3 CHANNELS music, on the Music bus. The two pulse voices call and answer and swap roles when the world flips, G minor, 124.1 BPM, 20 bars, with static; built on the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_4
sounds.trigger: Level 2-4 THE RELAY music, the World 2 boss, on the Music bus. Fast, relentless and urgent, F minor, 200 BPM, 32 bars, lightning every eight bars; built on the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: flyer_flap
sounds.trigger: A flyer flaps its wings (play now and then while one is on screen)

sounds.name: gust_tell
sounds.trigger: A gust is about to blow: plays for 0.5 s before gust

sounds.name: gust
sounds.trigger: A gust blows (plays as gust_tell ends)

sounds.name: arm_whir
sounds.trigger: Sweep arm on screen: a faint electric whir. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: updraft
sounds.trigger: Player enters an updraft

sounds.name: voice_spire
sounds.trigger: Spire (mast rigger) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: amb_w3
sounds.trigger: World 3 (the Aerials) ambience under the music: high wind, guy wires singing, the odd distant clank. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_3_1
sounds.trigger: Level 3-1 WAVE FLYERS music, on the Music bus. Buoyant and lilting, F major in 12/8, 85.7 dotted-quarter beats a minute, 16 bars; opens with the Aerials motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_3_2
sounds.trigger: Level 3-2 CARRIER WIND music, on the Music bus. Sweeping, with arpeggios that rise and fall like gusts, A major, 138.5 BPM, 24 bars; opens with the Aerials motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_3_3
sounds.trigger: Level 3-3 SWEEP ARMS music, on the Music bus. Circular and clockwork, a turning ostinato over tick-tock drums, F# minor, 128.6 BPM, 24 bars; opens with the Aerials motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_3_4
sounds.trigger: Level 3-4 THE SPIRE music, the World 3 finale, on the Music bus. Triumphant and building, C major lifting to D major, 156.5 BPM, 32 bars; the Aerials motif climbs from low to the top. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: title_intro
sounds.trigger: Title screen music intro (2 bars, plays once with the logo), on the Music bus. Play title_theme the moment it ends: the intro runs straight into it

sounds.name: title_theme
sounds.trigger: Title screen music, on the Music bus. Calm and hopeful, a little lonely. D major, 83.7 BPM, 14 bars. Play title_intro first: this file follows it with no gap. Keeps playing through Settings and Extras. LOOPS (the whole file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: menu_move_1
sounds.trigger: Title menu cursor lands on row 1 (row 1 is the lowest note, each row down the menu is higher)

sounds.name: menu_move_2
sounds.trigger: Title menu cursor lands on row 2 (row 1 is the lowest note, each row down the menu is higher)

sounds.name: menu_move_3
sounds.trigger: Title menu cursor lands on row 3 (row 1 is the lowest note, each row down the menu is higher)

sounds.name: menu_move_4
sounds.trigger: Title menu cursor lands on row 4 (row 1 is the lowest note, each row down the menu is higher)

sounds.name: menu_move_5
sounds.trigger: Title menu cursor lands on row 5 (row 1 is the lowest note, each row down the menu is higher)

sounds.name: menu_deny
sounds.trigger: Menu choice isn't available (like shop_deny, but shorter)

sounds.name: menu_tick
sounds.trigger: A settings slider moves one step (raise the pitch with the value, at most one every 60 ms)

sounds.name: title_start
sounds.trigger: New game or continue chosen on the title: the Spark leaves (plays over the 400 ms music fade)

sounds.name: arc_swing
sounds.trigger: Player throws the Arc (plays on every throw, hit or miss)

sounds.name: arc_hit
sounds.trigger: The Arc hits an enemy (play with arc_swing)

sounds.name: wall_crack
sounds.trigger: A cracked wall is hit but doesn't break yet (walls that take more than one hit)

sounds.name: wall_break
sounds.trigger: A cracked wall shatters (the Arc's last hit on it)

sounds.name: arc_learn
sounds.trigger: Player learns the Arc

sounds.name: intro_line
sounds.trigger: Story intro, cards 1 and 2, on the Music bus. Warm and a little old, like a music box. D major, 80 BPM, 4 bars, FIRST LIGHT passed from voice to voice. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: intro_noise
sounds.trigger: Story intro, cards 3 and 4, on the Music bus. Uneasy. D minor, 80 BPM, 4 bars. The code cuts it dead (20 ms fade) at 7.25 s, when the line is cut, and every voice is silent from 7.125 s to 7.5 s. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: intro_still
sounds.trigger: Story intro, card 6, on the Music bus. Tender and small. D minor, 80 BPM, 2 bars. Fades out as card 7 starts. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: intro_wake
sounds.trigger: Story intro, card 8, the Spark flares awake, on the Music bus. Plays once: a 0.2 s crackle, then the downbeat. Play intro_home the moment it ends: it runs straight into it

sounds.name: intro_home
sounds.trigger: Story intro, cards 8 (second half) to 10, on the Music bus. Relief and company. D major, 80 BPM, 6 bars, ending on A for village_theme to resolve. Play intro_wake first: this file follows it with no gap. LOOPS (the whole file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: line_pulse
sounds.trigger: Story intro card 2: a voice passes down the wire (at 1.5 s, and again at 3.3 s two semitones up)

sounds.name: static_crawl
sounds.trigger: Story intro cards 3 and 4: the noise crawling along the wire (pan it with the static). LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: lamp_off
sounds.trigger: Story intro cards 3 and 4: a station light dies (quieter and lower for distant lights)

sounds.name: wire_snap
sounds.trigger: Story intro card 4: the switch opens and the line breaks (lever_pull plays 0.35 s before it)

sounds.name: static_die
sounds.trigger: Story intro card 4: the noise fizzles out at the gap

sounds.name: line_ring
sounds.trigger: Story intro card 7: the dead line rings once (plays three times, one per ring)

sounds.name: spark_flare
sounds.trigger: Story intro card 8: the Spark flares awake (plays on intro_wake's downbeat)

sounds.name: caller_blip
sounds.trigger: Story intro cards 8 and 10: the far light answers (the two-note call from title_theme and amb_w1, with a softer echo)

sounds.name: pip_call
sounds.trigger: A trapped Pip calls from inside its glass insulator (every couple of seconds while the player is near, quieter with distance)

sounds.name: pip_free
sounds.trigger: Player breaks a Pip's glass insulator and the Pip flies home (replaces big_shard)

sounds.name: pip_home
sounds.trigger: Dot hands the player a reward for rescuing enough Pips (plays over village_theme)

sounds.name: howl_wake
sounds.trigger: Gate cutscene: far below, the Howl stirs awake (plays before its garbled speech types out)

sounds.name: voice_howl
sounds.trigger: The Howl speaks (its garbled text in the Gate cutscene): one blip every two letters

sounds.name: gate_wake
sounds.trigger: Gate cutscene: the first Gate wakes and its light races down the line into the Spark

sounds.name: turret_charge
sounds.trigger: A relay turret's eye brightens: play when its 0.3 s charge starts, it ends as the shot leaves (then turret_fire)

sounds.name: turret_fire
sounds.trigger: A relay turret fires its bolt (plays as turret_charge ends)

sounds.name: bolt_hit
sounds.trigger: A turret's bolt hits a wall and pops

sounds.name: echo_whine
sounds.trigger: An echo starts drifting toward the player (it only moves while they look away)

sounds.name: echo_hide
sounds.trigger: An echo covers its face (the player turned to look at it)

sounds.name: echo_knock
sounds.trigger: The player's Arc scatters an echo (play with arc_hit)

sounds.name: static_rise
sounds.trigger: A wall of static starts rising or chasing (then static_loop while it's on screen)

sounds.name: static_loop
sounds.trigger: The wall of static is on screen: a crackling bed. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: howl_roar
sounds.trigger: The Howl roars as the last chase begins (4-4)

sounds.name: ring_close
sounds.trigger: The Spark takes its place and the ring of Sparks closes (the end of 4-4)

sounds.name: amb_w4
sounds.trigger: World 4 (Dead Air) ambience under the music: the deep hum of dead equipment, far-off drips, and now and then a distant low howl. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_4_1
sounds.trigger: Level 4-1 RELAY TURRETS music, on the Music bus. Low, sparse and tense over a steady mechanical pulse, D minor, 100 BPM, 20 bars; opens with the Dead Air motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_4_2
sounds.trigger: Level 4-2 ECHOES IN THE DARK music, on the Music bus. The quietest track: hollow and eerie, with lots of space and a faint lead that answers itself, B minor, 80 BPM, 16 bars; opens with the Dead Air motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_4_3
sounds.trigger: Level 4-3 THE RISING STATIC music, on the Music bus. Urgent and climbing over a bass that rises every bar, E minor lifting to F# minor, 171.4 BPM, 32 bars; opens with the Dead Air motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_4_4
sounds.trigger: Level 4-4 THE LAST GATE music, the World 4 finale and the Howl's chase, on the Music bus. A driving, heroic chase, D minor turning to D major, 180 BPM, 32 bars; the Dead Air motif turns round and climbs as FIRST LIGHT. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_ending
sounds.trigger: Ending cutscene music, on the Music bus. Warm, hopeful and bright, D major, 90 BPM, 20 bars; FIRST LIGHT at half speed, as the intro plays it, climbing on and resolving to a held high D. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)
